articles.headline: Collin Dixon's 2 TD catches help Illinois become bowl eligible with 24-13 victory over Nebraska
articles.description: — Collin Dixon caught two touchdown passes including a record-breaker and Illinois used a trick play to set up its go-ahead TD as the Illini defeated Nebraska 24-13 on Friday night to become bowl eligible with their fourth straight victory.

article.story: Delaware (4-4) at Kennesaw State (2-6), Nov. 7 at 3 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Delaware by 2.5. Against the spread: Delaware 5-3, Kennesaw State 5-3. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats Delaware Offense Overall: 395.8 yards per game (58th in FBS) Passing: 286.3 yards per game (13th) Rushing: 109.5 yards per game (124th) Scoring: 29.1 points per game (63rd) Delaware Defense Overall: 406.5 yards per game (115th in FBS) Passing: 267.1 yards per game (130th) Rushing: 139.4 yards per game (66th) Scoring: 27.5 points per game (100th) Kennesaw State Offense Overall: 352.4 yards per game (99th in FBS) Passing: 222.9 yards per game (76th) Rushing: 129.5 yards per game (106th) Scoring: 23 points per game (102nd) Kennesaw State Defense Overall: 380 yards per game (94th in FBS) Passing: 221.3 yards per game (84th) Rushing: 158.8 yards per game (91st) Scoring: 25.4 points per game (79th) Kennesaw State ranks 121st in the FBS averaging 71.6 penalty yards per game, compared to Delaware's 63rd-ranked 54.6 per-game average. Kennesaw State is 136th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 96.6% of trips. Delaware's red zone offense ranks 31st, scoring on 89.7% of red zone opportunities. Kennesaw State is 133rd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 26:49. Team leaders Delaware Passing: Nick Minicucci, 1,477 yards, 14 TDs, 4 INTs, 65.3 completion percentage Rushing: Jo'Nathan Silver, 380 yards on 84 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Sean Wilson, 591 yards on 40 catches, 5 TDs Kennesaw State Passing: Rickie Collins, 1,617 yards, 7 TDs, 6 INTs, 69.9 completion percentage Rushing: Alan Woods III, 358 yards on 85 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Javon Rogers, 397 yards on 26 catches, 1 TD Last game Delaware beat Western Kentucky 35-21 on Oct. 27. Minicucci led Delaware with 414 yards on 32-of-38 passing (84.2%) for four touchdowns and no interceptions. Silver carried the ball 13 times for 49 yards, adding two receptions for 25 yards and one touchdown. Wilson put up 183 yards on nine catches with two touchdowns. Kennesaw State won 44-28 over Middle Tennessee on Oct. 28. Collins passed for 206 yards on 16-of-19 attempts (84.2%) with three touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 12 times for 29 yards. Woods had 67 rushing yards on 12 carries and two touchdowns, adding two receptions for one yard. Dylan Gary put up 59 yards on two catches with two touchdowns. Next game Delaware hosts Florida International on Nov. 14. Kennesaw State plays at Sam Houston on Nov. 14.
